subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage-accounting stack, or prioritize the narrower fork-identity and cache-invalidation repair in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both approaches address the same user-visible overcount but establish different implementation boundaries; selecting the permanent accounting architecture and landing order requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt lineage stack
options.body: Rebase the stack onto current main, land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 first, and require exact-head proof for each integration layer.

options.title: Prefer narrow repair
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause this stack until a remaining accounting gap demonstrates the need for the broader architecture.

options.title: Request consolidation
options.body: Ask for a smaller landing plan that combines the validated identity/cache repair with only the necessary lineage components.

recommendation.title: Adopt lineage stack
recommendation.body: Rebase the stack onto current main, land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 first, and require exact-head proof for each integration layer.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for the accounting architecture and stacked landing sequence.
